structuralIdentityNote: With role capacity parity retained, positive-depth parity and anchored absolute-row parity are equivalent recodings per local column role; no duplicate anchored-parity rung is required.
antiCircularity: All depth labels are defined from current-rank residual structure and support geometry before W/D/L qualification.
The ladder is frozen coarsest-first before any mixed-class result is inspected.
No descriptor split, depth threshold, or exception may be introduced from outcome labels.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: Any mixed scalar class rejects that candidate as a whole-component Q-V identity on the affected carrier.
The exact ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE control must reproduce its frozen class count and zero mixed scalar classes on every carrier.
A coarser candidate may be selected only if it has zero mixed scalar classes on every declared carrier.

nextIfFrontierOnlyPasses: Freeze frontier-versus-positive depth as the preferred structural identity and rerun decoder dimension/OOO dependency analysis in that compressed coordinate before motif fitting.
nextIfRparPasses: Freeze frontier-plus-positive-depth-parity as the preferred structural identity and rerun decoder dimension/OOO dependency analysis in that compressed coordinate before motif fitting.
nextIfOnlyExactPasses: Retain exact depth in ROLE_CAPPAR and proceed with mechanically generated OOO dependency motif/circuit functionals.
interpretationGuards: This is an MSS/Q-V identity-compression test, not formula qualification.
